request: Analyze GSE185154 for PMID 37395281 (CDK4-E2F3 signals enhance oxidative skeletal muscle fiber numbers and function to affect myogenesis and metabolism.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

accessions: GSE101820 (human muscle arrays, separate cohort, not analyzed here)
final.assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, quadriceps (QA) and soleus (SOL), mouse, n = 3 per group (S4.11.p1)

factors.exercise: not a factor of the RNA-seq; exercise appears only in qPCR/western experiments (S2.5.p1, FIG4, Supplemental Figure 11)

final.sample_inclusion: 30 sequenced samples = 5 genotypes x 2 muscles x 3 mice; all sedentary/unexercised as described
final.primary_estimand: Effect of Cdk4/E2F3 genotype on muscle transcriptome (Cdk4 R/R vs WT in QA, FIG2D; Cdk4 KO vs WT in soleus, FIG3B; E2F3 mKO vs MLC-Cre in soleus, FIG5C). No exercise estimand is defined for the RNA-seq.
planned_contrasts: Cdk4 R/R vs Cdk4 WT, quadriceps (FIG2D-F; count not reported)
Cdk4 KO vs Cdk4 WT, soleus (FIG3B-C; count not reported)
E2F3 mKO vs E2F3 WT, soleus (FIG5C-D; count not reported)
Overlaps: 199 genes RR & E2F3mKO, 483 genes KO & E2F3mKO (FIG6A, FIG6D; DEGs at P < 0.05)
final.exercise_contrast: none in GSE185154; exercise effects (MyoD1, Pgc-1a, E2F3, p16) are measured by qPCR and western blot (S2.5.p1, FIG4A-C)
final.normalization: featureCounts, RPKM (S4.11.p1); GEO deposits FPKM only
final.paper_results: No DEG counts per contrast are given; overlap counts 199 and 483 (FIG6) use DEGs at P < 0.05

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S4.11.p1 describes QA and soleus RNA-seq, n = 3 per group, DESeq2, adjusted P < 0.05. S4.15.p1 names GSE185154. The RNA-seq figures (FIG2D, FIG3B, FIG5C, FIG6) compare genotypes only. Exercise in this paper is a phenotype test (treadmill capacity, S4.3.p1) and a qPCR/western experiment in WT and Cdk4 R/R mice (S2.5.p1, FIG4A-C, Supplemental Figure 11); none of it was sequenced.

checks: S4.15.p1 names GSE185154 as the RNA-seq deposit
metadata series_id = GSE185154; contact at NIH matches the authors' institution
30 samples = 5 genotypes (Wild Type, CDK4RR, CDK4KO, MLC-Cre, E2F3-mKO) x quadriceps/soleus x 3, matching S4.11.p1 (n = 3 each group) and the genotypes of FIG2/3/5
matrix file name GSE185154_30_samples_QA_SOL_muscle carries the accession and 30 sample columns

ownership.reasoning: The paper names the accession; samples, tissues and genotypes match the paper's RNA-seq description.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (QW1, SR2, ...) are the bracketed codes at the end of the GEO title (inspect alignment_keys: 30/30). Exact match on that derived key. Genotype and tissue come from the characteristics columns.

matrix.reasoning: Values are non-integer (integer fraction 0.65 driven by zeros, Gnai3 = 2.62) and GEO data_processing says the supplementary file holds FPKM values computed from featureCounts. The paper ran DESeq2 on counts (S4.11.p1), which are not deposited; any DE here would need limma on log2(FPKM+1) as a declared deviation.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples. GSE185154 contains only genotype (Cdk4 WT/RR/KO, MLC-Cre, E2F3 mKO) x muscle (QA, soleus) groups with n = 3, all without an exercise intervention; the paper's exercise data (S2.5.p1, FIG4A-C, Supplemental Figure 11) are qPCR/western, not RNA-seq. The genotype contrasts the paper did sequence do not answer how exercise affects gene expression, and no column of the metadata defines exercise.

candidates.value: genotype contrasts (RR vs WT in QA; KO vs WT and E2F3mKO vs MLCCre in soleus)
candidates.reason_rejected: valid paper contrasts but they estimate a genetic effect, not an exercise effect; relabeling them as exercise would misstate the estimand

candidates.value: soleus vs quadriceps (oxidative vs glycolytic muscle)
candidates.reason_rejected: tissue comparison, not exercise; not a paper contrast

design.reasoning: The request is an exercise effect. The paper's RNA-seq (S4.11.p1, FIG2D, FIG3B, FIG5C, FIG6) compares genotypes in unexercised mice; the metadata has no exercise, training or time column. The estimand cannot be identified from these data.

discrepancies.data: GEO supplementary file holds FPKM only
discrepancies.disposition: would require limma on log2(FPKM+1) as a declared deviation; moot because the case stops at design

discrepancies.data: FIG5C and FIG6A/D legends use P < 0.05 for DEGs and overlaps
discrepancies.disposition: recorded; moot because the case stops at design

discrepancies.paper: exercise effects measured by qPCR/western in WT and Cdk4 R/R mice (S2.5.p1, FIG4)
